snippets.title: Python Context Manager Timer
snippets.description: Measure execution time of a block using time.perf_counter and contextlib.
snippets.content:
from contextlib import contextmanager
import time
from collections.abc import Iterator

@contextmanager
def timed_block(label: str) -> Iterator[None]:
    start = time.perf_counter()
    try:
        yield
    finally:
        elapsed_ms = (time.perf_counter() - start) * 1000
        print(f"{label}: {elapsed_ms:.2f} ms")

snippets.title: Python Atomic File Write
snippets.description: Write UTF-8 text atomically via a temporary sibling file and os.replace.
snippets.content:
import os
from pathlib import Path
import tempfile

def atomic_write(path: Path, data: str) -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    fd, tmp = tempfile.mkstemp(dir=path.parent, prefix=f".{path.name}.")
    try:
        with os.fdopen(fd, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
            fh.write(data)
            fh.flush()
            os.fsync(fh.fileno())
        os.replace(tmp, path)
    except BaseException:
        if os.path.exists(tmp):
            os.unlink(tmp)
        raise

snippets.title: SQLite Online Backup Snippet
snippets.description: Create a hot consistent SQLite backup using sqlite3.Connection.backup.
snippets.content:
import sqlite3
from pathlib import Path

def backup_sqlite(src: Path, dst: Path) -> None:
    with sqlite3.connect(src) as src_conn, sqlite3.connect(dst) as dst_conn:
        src_conn.backup(dst_conn)

snippets.title: SQL Recursive Directory Tree CTE
snippets.description: Traverse hierarchical parent-child folders with a recursive common table expression.
snippets.content:
WITH RECURSIVE folder_tree AS (
    SELECT id, parent_id, name, name AS full_path, 0 AS depth
    FROM folders
    WHERE parent_id IS NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT f.id, f.parent_id, f.name, ft.full_path || '/' || f.name, ft.depth + 1
    FROM folders f
    JOIN folder_tree ft ON f.parent_id = ft.id
)
SELECT id, depth, full_path
FROM folder_tree
ORDER BY full_path;

snippets.title: Multi-Stage Python Dockerfile with Non-Root User
snippets.description: Minimal production container image using virtual environments and unprivileged user.
snippets.content:
FROM python:3.12-slim AS builder
WORKDIR /build
RUN python -m venv /opt/venv
ENV PATH="/opt/venv/bin:$PATH"
COPY pyproject.toml README.md ./
COPY src ./src
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir .

FROM python:3.12-slim
RUN useradd --create-home --uid 10001 appuser
COPY --from=builder /opt/venv /opt/venv
ENV PATH="/opt/venv/bin:$PATH"
USER appuser
WORKDIR /home/appuser
ENTRYPOINT ["snipvault"]

snippets.title: GitHub Actions Matrix CI Workflow
snippets.description: Run ruff, mypy, and pytest across macOS and Ubuntu in GitHub Actions.
snippets.content:
name: CI
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [macos-14, ubuntu-latest]
        python-version: ['3.11', '3.12']
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
      - run: pip install -e ".[dev]"
      - run: pytest -q
